shots.text: Ashwick had been the Concord's youngest messenger. Two years ago he ran east to the Rift with a letter, and never came back. When he fell in the reeds, his satchel split open. The letter was still in it, under Cassivane's seal.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Ashwick stumbling in the reeds, embers scattering, the satchel falling open: a letter stamped with the Lord Marshal's seal lands in the snow.

shots.text: In the middle of the burning reeds stood a tower of ice that had not melted. Inside it was Mirelle, a blind Tidefolk seer who reads the future in ice. She had kept forty children alive in there.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: A tower of ice in a ring of fire; inside, Mirelle, small, pearls sewn on everything, blind eyes glowing teal, holding an ice staff, children huddled behind her.

shots.text: You're late. Only a little. I saw that too.
shots.speaker: mirelle
shots.art_note: Mirelle stepping out onto the frost, barefoot. Joins as a hero.
